classification: Unproduced metadata properties in the checked native addon browser/info path; no historical Kodi removal version established.
native_property_reader: GUIInfoManager::GetMultiInfoItemLabel LISTITEM_PROPERTY reads item->GetProperty(key).asString(); no addon-manifest fallback.
native_item_chain: CAddonsDirectory::FileItemFromAddon creates this item and sets Addon.ID, Addon.Name, optional Addon.Language
Browser list paths set Addon.Status for applicable states
CGUIDialogAddonInfo::SetItem copies the supplied file item
retained_fields: Supported AddonCreator/Version/Type/Origin/install-date/summary and other existing dedicated labels unchanged.
removed_special_case: A third-party manually injected item carrying these five custom properties would no longer display those extra rows. No such producer was established for the native contexts used here.
runtime_scope: No new Kodi launch. Existing addon origin tests only prove the retained ID/Status cases; they did not query all removed properties. Source-path proof is the basis of this change.
